description: FREE headline pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the record is well-formed, its signature valid, and whether it is a duplicate; no receipt is issued.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

record.description: The per-step record object, signed by its performer (record_type, run_id, step_id, performer, effect_class, payload_hash — hashes only, never payload content — evidence_refs, signer_pubkey_b64, signature_b64).

name: execution_receipt_precheck
